what_failed.measured: gross profitability t 1.12, asset growth t 0.66; both flip sign between halves of the sample

what_failed.claim: Beating the T-bill rate (Risk-Adjusted) ranks stocks by future return
what_failed.measured: IC −0.006 at 21 days — the only horizon whose significance is trustworthy, since 63d and 126d windows overlap. Longer horizons drift positive (+0.012, +0.024) but cannot be read as evidence.
what_failed.outcome: The verdict was withheld for months because the backtest ran a flat 19% rate against a policy rate whose true median over the window was 9.40%. Dated rates lifted the withholding; the category still carries 13% of the default weight on no measured edge.
